LESSON: VIRTUES • ADALAH (JUSTICE)

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.1: Virtues • Adalah (Justice)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Virtues • Adalah (Justice), part of Akhlaq (Moral Teachings) in Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What are the benefits of observing adalah in the society? 2. How can a pupil practise adalah in school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss the importance of exercising justice and make class presentation,

2. search for verses in the Qur’an that advocate for fairness (Q. 4:135),

3. read a story on justice and draw lessons on fairness,

4. role-play actions that depict justice,

5. make and present short skits thematising adalah in society. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss the importance of exercising justice and make class presentation,
2. search for verses in the Qur’an that advocate for fairness (Q. 4:135),
3. read a story on justice and draw lessons on fairness,
4. role-play actions that depict justice,
5. make and present short skits thematising adalah in society. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Virtues • Adalah (Justice) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: interacting with digital technology skill achieved through the search for the meaning of adalah and related

verses on adalah.

• Communication and Collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills attained through group discussion and

presentation.

• Creativity and Imagination: the skill of networking enhanced as learners perform short skits thematising adalah.

Values:
Social justice: there is equity as learners discuss the importance of exercising justice and make class presentation.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship: Good governance enhanced as learners discuss the significance of upholding adalah.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Social studies: covers aspects of human rights and justice.
